body:
Takeover QA findings from GF content sweep:

1) scripts/lint-exam-json.js FAIL: 80 errors across RP3-9 (missing answer fields on explanatory inputs, unicode escape issues in RP6/7).
2) tests/lint-math-json.js FAIL: 13 errors, 44 warnings (overlong hints, unicode escapes, giveaway hints).
3) tests/f-validation/exam-cross-exam-dedup.test.js advisory: 4 hard duplicates involving RP7 (q7/q10/q11) and RP6 (q1).

Request:
- GR: patch JSON schema errors + dedup collisions first.
- GA: confirm renderer expectations for explanatory inputs without answers before we normalize schema.

I can re-run full QA immediately after patches and post pass/fail gate.
subject: Takeover QA findings: RP3-9 lint failures + dedup collisions
